# @skillship/min-example-sdk

Auto-generated TypeScript SDK for min.example.

## Install

```sh
npm install @skillship/min-example-sdk
```

## Authentication

Set the following environment variables before constructing the client:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|----------|----------|-------------|
| `MIN_EXAMPLE_TOKEN` | Yes | Bearer token |

With these set, `new Client({ baseUrl: "..." })` needs no auth option — the client picks them up automatically.
Passing `auth` explicitly overrides the environment.

### Bearer token

```ts
import { Client, attachResources } from "@skillship/min-example-sdk";

const client = attachResources(
  new Client({
    baseUrl: "https://api.example.com",
    auth: { kind: "bearer", token: process.env.MIN_EXAMPLE_TOKEN! },
  }),
);
```

## Custom token provider

Use `tokenProvider` as an escape hatch for auth schemes not covered above
(e.g. signed tokens, OIDC, proxy injection):

```ts
import { Client, attachResources } from "@skillship/min-example-sdk";

const client = attachResources(
  new Client({
    baseUrl: "https://api.example.com",
    auth: {
      kind: "tokenProvider",
      getToken: async () => yourTokenFetcher(),
    },
  }),
);
```

## Make a request

```ts
import { Client, attachResources } from "@skillship/min-example-sdk";

const client = attachResources(new Client({ baseUrl: "https://api.example.com", auth: { /* ... */ } }));

const result = await client.projects.list();
```

## Retries

Failed requests are retried automatically (up to 2 retries) for
idempotent methods on retryable status codes (408–409, 429, 500, 502–504).
POST/PATCH are retried only on 408 and 429.
The `Retry-After` response header is honored when present.

## Use with Claude Code

This package ships an MCP server exposing every operation as a tool. Add it
to a `.mcp.json` next to your `sdk/` directory:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "min-example": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["sdk/bin/mcp.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

Set the auth and base-URL env vars from the [Authentication](#authentication)
table before launching. The server runs the SDK's TypeScript directly, so it
requires **Node >=23.6**.
